description: This file defines the abstract class KeyValueGroupedDataset, which provides grouping and aggregation operations for datasets in Apache Spark SQL. It includes methods for transforming, reducing, and cogrouping grouped datasets, with support for both Scala and Java APIs.

classes.name: KeyValueGroupedDataset
classes.description: An abstract class representing a dataset grouped by a user-specified key, providing methods for transformations and aggregations on grouped data.

methods.name: keyAs
methods.description: Returns a new KeyValueGroupedDataset with the key type mapped to a different type.

methods.name: mapValues
methods.description: Applies a function to the values in the dataset, keeping the key unchanged.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns a Dataset containing all the unique keys.

methods.name: flatMapGroups
methods.description: Applies a function to each group of data, returning a Dataset of arbitrary type.

methods.name: flatMapSortedGroups
methods.description: Applies a function to each sorted group of data, with optional sorting expressions.

methods.name: mapGroups
methods.description: Applies a function to each group, returning a Dataset of results.

methods.name: mapGroupsWithState
methods.description: Applies a function to each group with user-defined state, supporting streaming stateful processing.

methods.name: reduceGroups
methods.description: Reduces elements within each group using a binary function.

methods.name: agg
methods.description: Performs aggregations on grouped data, returning datasets of tuples with aggregation results.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of items per key.

methods.name: cogroup
methods.description: Applies a function to cogrouped datasets, combining elements from two datasets by key.

methods.name: cogroupSorted
methods.description: Applies a function to sorted cogrouped datasets with specified sort expressions.

methods.name: transformWithState
methods.description: Invokes methods in a stateful processor for advanced streaming state management.
